status: 探索候选，未确认全游戏美术风格
shared_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Deliverable: ONE highly finished THREE-PANEL ART-DIRECTION COMPARISON BOARD for a playable third-person 3D game. Landscape about 2048x1536, 4:3. No writing, letters, numbering, captions, logo, watermark or UI. Thin neutral ivory gutters separate panels. All three panels must show the SAME WORLD, CHARACTER, MATERIALS AND ART DIRECTION. This is a detailed 3D GAME VISUAL TARGET, not a flat illustration, photo, generic low-poly render or movie poster.
THREE SHARED QUALITY REQUIREMENTS, EQUALLY IMPORTANT:
1. DISTANT/WHOLE: beautiful overall composition, designed color relationships, atmospheric depth, convincing scale and coherent lighting. Landscape ground has rich designed dirt, little stones, grass and wear; never a giant flat single-color surface.
2. MIDDLE: every building, boat and character has purposeful silhouette, elegant proportions, thoughtful shape rhythms and legible working structure. Models are authored forms, not generic primitives with texture.
3. CLOSE: genuinely beautiful carefully selected structure and surface detail—wood joinery, worn contact edges, pottery rim, hemp fiber and cloth folds, forged iron fittings and fasteners. Detail follows construction and use; it is composed and selective, not random decoration, dirt everywhere, microtexture noise or a screen-space filter.
LOCKED WORLD AND OBJECTS FOR ALL BOARDS:
A modest ancient EAST ASIAN village port on the edge of a floating island, slowly developing production alongside village life. Cultural period and industrial power source are intentionally undecided. Natural ordinary materials: timber, ochre rammed earth, grey clay tiles, stone, red/brown brick, rough pottery, hemp, iron and small amounts of simple glass. One ordinary one-storey 6x5m rammed-earth timber-frame house, grey tiled gable roof with very slight eave lift, plain door and square lattice window, stone footing. One modest low 12x8m rectangular brick-and-timber MANUFACTURING HALL behind the house: three repeated structural bays, a simple grey-tile gable roof, tall double cargo door and regularly spaced dark-framed rectangular windows; a clear loading area and modest stock of metal components inside the opening. It is a practical modest factory/workshop, not another house or a palace. Do not specify or show a power plant, fuel source, decorative gears, steam engine, chimney or smoke.
One SMALL WOODEN SAILING AIRBOAT, 7.5m long, 2.6m wide, open central cargo deck, low stern steering position, single mast with a plain cream rectangular sail and five horizontal battens, ordinary functional rigging and one short gangplank to a simple timber quay. Entire sail and mast must fit in the upper panel. Floatstone compartment is opaque, hidden inside the hull. THREE plain wooden cargo chests, FOUR hemp sacks, one squat reddish-brown pottery jar, simple mooring posts and ropes. No ornate figurehead or flags. Quay has short brackets fixed to nearby cliff, no piles extending into clouds.
Same ordinary YOUNG ADULT EAST ASIAN male working boatman, about 23, small practical black hair bun, faded INDIGO wrap-front hip-length work jacket, forearms exposed, brown cloth sash, undyed cropped hemp trousers and straw sandals. No jewellery, weapon, fancy embroidery, cape or extra costume layers. An individual capable adult, not a cute child, pinup, idol or muscular action hero. Exactly three other ordinary villagers in the main scene. Do not add ornamental clutter to make a style seem richer.
Three modest vegetated floating islands in the far distance, earth/rock undersides, quiet CLOUD SEA below. No water, waterfalls or giant spectacular mountains.
Same fair-weather 10AM sunlight from upper-left, gentle open skylight, neutral exposure and readable soft-to-medium shadows. Sky pale blue, sail cream, roofs grey, wood warm dark brown, clothes indigo, foliage natural green; style may organize temperature and chroma but preserve these material identities. No sunset, night, magical light, dramatic godrays or strong bokeh in the main view.
LOCKED BOARD LAYOUT:
TOP PANEL = full width, upper 58 percent. A wide playable eye-level 35mm-like establishing view from the dirt approach: ordinary house at left, manufacturing hall a little farther back center-left, quay and small cargo airboat at right, visible walkable route linking them, human-scale people doing daily work. Horizon around upper third of this panel, moderate cloud-sea depth, clearly visible whole mast. Strong coherent overall composition, no epic scale cheat.
BOTTOM LEFT PANEL = left 48 percent of lower 42 percent. Medium character view from knees up at the quay, same boatman three-quarter toward viewer, relaxed expression, hands handling a short coil of hemp rope. The factory's loading doorway and one repeated bay behind him are recognizable but subordinate. Read individual face design, hair, garment fold construction and painted/sculpted form at this distance.
BOTTOM RIGHT PANEL = right 52 percent of lower 42 percent. A beautifully composed close view of the SAME boat's mooring corner and adjacent quay, not a separate asset collage: wooden rail and deck meeting in a credible joint, forged iron bracket with small fasteners, worn wooden mooring cleat, one hemp rope loop with a knot, one edge of a cargo chest with batten construction, part of the squat ceramic jar and folded hemp cloth. Clear focal hierarchy: wood/iron joint first, rope and pottery second, broad calm areas to rest the eye. Show tactility and craft without excessive scratches, rust or decorative ornament. No disembodied hands in this close view.
CRITICAL FAIRNESS: same number, function, approximate physical scale and arrangement of all objects, same weather/time/quality/detail budget. Styles differ through CHARACTER DESIGN, SCULPTED SHAPE RHYTHMS, MATERIAL MARK-MAKING, COLOR RELATIONSHIPS and LIGHT/SHADOW LANGUAGE. Do not produce merely three realism levels, a denser/more ornate version, or one beautiful style and two rough drafts. All styles must be equally rich, beautiful and fully designed at all three viewing distances.
Avoid torii, European medieval architecture, futuristic industry, steampunk ornament, magic, glowing floatstone, crystals, symbols, franchise characters and copied signature assets.

styles.name: 精绘日式三维
styles.prompt:
TARGET ART DIRECTION E1: richly hand-painted Japanese 3D RPG art in the visual family of GRANBLUE FANTASY: RELINK, adapted to ORIGINAL EAST ASIAN working village/industry. NOT flat anime cel shading. The ambition is walking inside a richly painted illustration while seeing solid authored models.
CHARACTER: elegant but grounded adult 7-head proportions, expressive carefully drawn anime eyes and brows, small individual angular nose, quiet focused face; beautiful compact sculpted hair locks/bun; large coherent folds with fine selective line accents. He is a working young adult in a simple jacket, never an ornate RPG hero.
SHAPE LANGUAGE: flowing long curves and precise small structural accents, rhythmically composed timber/eaves, subtly tapered functional masses, economical elegant iron fittings, hand-designed silhouettes. All objects retain modest usable construction.
PAINTING: fine directional HAND-PAINTED diffuse texture and painted form shading, subtly visible brush strokes and selective dark line accents that articulate joins, complemented by consistent 3D daylight. Rich local color variation in wood and dirt, carefully grouped vegetation, no photo texture. Color design luminous azure air, jade/olive foliage, warm ochre and cream sunlit masses, translucent-looking blue-violet shade, warm chestnut wood, indigo cloth. Highlights and material transitions are beautifully painted rather than shiny.
DETAIL: warmly crafted tiny structural marks, wood grain following planes, subtle cloth weave and seam placement, glaze variation only at pottery contact/rim, controlled small iron highlights. Choose detail where it matters; don't decorate the objects. Every panel unmistakably shares this precise painterly anime 3D language. No flat floor, pervasive black outline, watercolor paper wash, faceted triangle mosaics, toy clay or generic realistic CGI.

styles.name: 动画电影式三维
styles.prompt:
TARGET ART DIRECTION E2: richly tactile ANIMATED-FEATURE-STYLE THREE-DIMENSIONAL GAME ART, the expressive sculpted naturalism family of KENA: BRIDGE OF SPIRITS, adapted to ORIGINAL EAST ASIAN village AND industrial buildings without magical elements. Equal refinement and detail to E1, but a distinctly different SHAPE and CHARACTER system.
CHARACTER: grounded adult about 6.5-head proportions, slightly broader working hands and compact sturdy torso; sculpturally rounded cheeks and a clear adult jaw, lively smaller natural-shaped eyes, individualized gently asymmetric brows/nose, no oversized anime eyes or anime fringe. Broad flowing sculpted hair masses form the bun. Capable warm adult, not baby, toy or superhero.
SHAPE LANGUAGE: subtly hand-shaped weighty convex volumes with compressed and stretched proportions, organic rounded edges, strong tactile contact points, beautifully grouped foliage crowns, timber beams feel hand-hewn and substantial. House and factory remain structurally usable; metal brackets robust and elegant, no cute decorative transformations.
MATERIALS AND LIGHT: finely authored coarse wood pores and grain, compressed rammed-earth strata, matte brick variation, pottery's thick imperfect rim, woven hemp and natural directional fibers. Refined PBR-like roughness and soft 3D subsurface feel only where appropriate; natural richly modulated surfaces never photo scans. No drawn outlines or ink hatching. Broad soft light rolls across substantial modeled surfaces; warm creams, olive/fern greens, chestnut/ochre construction and soft cool blue shade, lively clean daylight without a glossy toy sheen.
DETAIL: crafted bevels, well-placed wear, believable cloth seams and shape-dependent microtexture, same amount of meaningful detail as E1. Strong readability and beauty from whole world to tactile close-up, no generic realism, no triangle facets, no flat cartoon surface, no enchanted forest, creatures or film-only extravagance.

styles.name: 成熟绘画式三维
styles.prompt:
TARGET ART DIRECTION E3: mature PAINTERLY SCULPTURAL THREE-DIMENSIONAL GAME WORLD, inspired by the expressive painted-CG principles of ARCANE and richly authored immersive-game environments, sunny ORIGINAL EAST ASIAN civilian working adaptation. Equal beauty and detail to E1/E2, no grimdark filter, no imported industrial setting.
CHARACTER: individual 7.5-head ADULT human with lean capable build, broad angular cheek planes, natural small/deep-set eyes, slightly crooked strong nose, expressive asymmetric brows, calm wry expression; elegant working forearms and hands. Sculpted hair/bun as directional mass, not photoreal strands. No anime eyes/fringe, child proportions, glamour model or heroic muscles.
SHAPE LANGUAGE: composed long angular planes and selective curved relief, deliberate asymmetry in hand-worked objects, crisp rhythmic repeated factory bays, strong interesting silhouettes, the beautifully controlled planes of an oil-painted sculpture. Specific personality in mundane construction, no extra decoration.
MATERIALS AND LIGHT: directional opaque BRUSH STROKES and subtle scumbling following modeled planes, nuanced painted reflections and colored half-tones, edges deliberately alternately crisp and softly brushed. Keep structural microdetail at joins and contact edges, never random triangle-patch mosaic. Broad warm ochre/sienna light, desaturated petrol-green foliage, chestnut timber, steel-blue and muted plum shadows, ivory cloud highlights with a clear blue morning sky. Beautiful rich surface variation and readable midtone depth; no full-screen oil-paint filter, heavy black outline, photo scans or dull muddy grading.
DETAIL: individually authored wood joinery, iron hammer/working marks, cloth seam and crease rhythms, pottery irregularity, controlled wear located at use; high material craft combined with graphic compositional hierarchy. The manufacturing hall belongs naturally with the rural house and boat. No steampunk, neon, smoke, violence, dystopian grime or cinematic extravagance.
